finding: the kernel's first instruction (1181 8189 4100 acb7) compares r0 (the local ID) with common-store half 4, i.e. dword 2, which must hold the threads per group in both halves (0x00010001 for one thread), and disables the lanes past it. If dword 2 is 0 the only lane is off: the kernel runs to its end, stores nothing and faults on nothing
source: g9p_isa.h 136-153 ('compares the thread count in the common store ... with r0 and disables the lanes past it'; 8189 = 8181 or 2 x 4)

finding: the kernel's PDS DOUTW (f0024001): source temps q0 (the local ID), control word = data dword 2 = 0x80000000 (LAST, unified store, register 0, lower 32 bits). So r0 = local ID before the prologue; 0x80000000 is that control word, not a value the store uses
source: pvr_rogue_pds_defs.h DOUTW SRC1 fields; g5p_cdm.h (A8 DOUTW = 0xf0004001 or ctrl << 16); g9p-cdm.h (G9P_PDS_TEMPS: q0 = local ID)

finding: the binding DMA's second DOUTD: control word 0x90004001 = LAST (31), common store (28), address offset 2 (bits 13+), BSIZE 1: one dword from src1 (entry + 8 = 0x00010001) to common dword 2. The first DOUTD's 0x10000002 = common store, offset 0, BSIZE 2: the output VA to dwords 0/1
source: pvr_rogue_pds_defs.h DOUTD SRC1 (LAST 31, DEST 28, AO 13, BSIZE 0)

finding: the A8 DOUT carries the control word's data-dword index in bits 16-23. Metal's binding code f0040000 f4060100 reads its control words from data dwords 4 and 6 (A10's f0001000 f4001808 decode the same: 4 and 6), i.e. Metal's 32-byte data is {q0 = src0, q1 = src1, q2 = 0x10000002 (dword 4), q3 = 0x90004001 (dword 6)}. Orchard's Mesa packs the control words at dwords 4 and 5 and encodes f0040000 f4050100 to match. If J2c's data has 0x90004001 at dword 5 with Metal's f4060100, the second DMA reads dword 6 = 0: common dword 2 stays empty, the lane is disabled, and the job completes with no store and no fault (runs 96-98). Fix either side: data dword 6 = 0x90004001 (dword 5 = 0), or code word 2 = 0xf4050100
source: a8/M2 ('f0040000 f4060100 d3000000'); a10/COMPUTE.md ('f0001000 f4001808'); pvr_arch_g5p_compute.c 553-605 (ctrl0 = 2 x transfers; data[ctrl0 + k]; DOUT ctrl ctrl0 + k)

finding: cdm.xml KERNEL1: 'When set, the allocation size specified in USC_COMMON_SIZE is for Shared Registers, instead of Coefficients.' Record 0 allocates one 64-byte chunk of shared registers and DMAs the binding into it; the kernel record (usc_common 0) reads those shared registers, as Metal's stream does. J2c matches Metal here
K0 0x2106 (no fence on the A8), K8 0x40000000, sd_type 0 and the PDS temp size 1 all match Metal's and Orchard's A8 plain launch; nothing else is required
fc000002 is DOUTU with END and CC, as Metal and Orchard's A8 plain launch use it behind c2c00002 (branch past it on the IF1 pass)
